scientific_integrity: A proved structural result for an explicitly idealized conditional logistic model; no claims of empirical calibration, causal inference, validation, or literature-exhaustive novelty.
scientific_limitations: Shared positive weather slope for every stage and treatment
Exactly the same finite number of required conditional stages
No uncertainty bounds or field parameter estimates
Classical polynomial algebra and proportional-odds reliability are acknowledged as background
title: Sharp reversal ceiling for staged logistic wildfire severity under competing fuel treatments
